decision.changed_angle: No new event is claimed. The existing mining-to-AI thesis is retained only as a shortened side continuation after the latest completed price move; financing and operating execution remain the tests.

The prospective ETF/treasury-demand narrative is unchanged, so it is explicitly retained as a brief side continuation, with no approval or completed buying inferred and direct-token/wrapper risks separated.

The previous lead examined a falling share price against the reset narrative. The September17 national-expansion plan and named short-seller attention introduce a new operating/capital requirement and a distinct attention contest, warranting a short follow-up rather than a repeated full essay.

This entry moves from IonQ acquisition and sector-platform enthusiasm to Rigetti’s own AirForce award. It assesses a specific customer-related event and its conversion to deliveries/economics, rather than treating another quantum firm’s financing as Rigetti business.
